description: 后翼弃兵 D20 — 练习：吃到了兵，空间换出去了吗？

intro.popup_en:
Space Cramp, Practice 7
Black captures White's pawn on move two and wins material, but at what cost? Follow White's d4-e4 center and decide whether the extra pawn is worth the loss of space.
intro.popup:
空间挤压 练习7

黑方第2手吃了白方的兵！
赢得了物质……但代价是什么？

跟踪白方d4+e4中心的建立
判断：黑方的便宜值得吗？

outro.popup_en: Material versus space: White has a strong d4-e4 center, while Black is a pawn up but has a vulnerable position. Black should develop with ...Nbd7 and ...Nc5 to attack Bd3, then play ...Be7 and castle quickly. Do not allow White to establish a knight on d5.
outro.popup:
物质 vs 空间

白方有d4+e4强中心
黑方有多一个兵但中心虚弱

黑方应该：
Nbd7→Nc5攻击d3象
Be7→O-O快速稳固

不能让白方建立d5跳入！

moves.popup: c4！后翼弃兵！白方邀请黑方吃兵
moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit invites Black to capture the pawn.
...dxc4 wins a pawn, but leaves d5 empty. This is the Queen's Gambit Accepted.
moves.popup:
dxc4！黑方吃兵！
赢得一个兵，但d5变空了……
这就是后翼弃兵接受变（QGA）

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and prepares to recover the pawn on c4.
e3 reinforces the center and prepares Bxc4.
Bxc4! The bishop reaches an excellent square and controls the b3-f7 diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bxc4！象发展到绝佳格！
对角线控制b3-f7

moves.popup_en: ...b5! Black counterattacks, drives the bishop from c4, and gains queenside space.
moves.popup:
b5！黑方反击！驱赶Bc4
翼翼扩张争夺空间

moves.popup_en: Bd3 retreats and prepares the e4 advance.
...cxd4 exchanges pawns, leaving White with an isolated d-pawn, but White is ready to build an e4-d4 center.
moves.popup:
cxd4 黑方兑换
白方d4孤兵——但e4马上来了！

moves.popup_en: exd4 recaptures and creates the beginnings of a strong d4-e4 center.
moves.popup:
exd4 白方重新占中心
现在d4+e4=白方的强中心雏形！

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 develops along the diagonal, with ...Rc8 or ...Ne7 available after castling.
moves.popup:
Bb7 象发展到对角线
准备O-O后活动Rc8或Ne7

moves.popup_en: Qe2! White prepares e4. If the center advances, which of Black's pieces will become restricted? Can Black activate them before White plays e4? d5 is White's key target square; how should Black defend it?
moves.popup:
Qe2！准备e4推进！

⭐ 练习问题：
白方e4推进后，黑方哪些子力会受限？
黑方该如何快速活动子力抢在e4之前？

d5是白方的目标格——黑方如何防守？
